parsed_result.summary: Initializes a local librarian context pack for downstream project generation by consolidating the user's requested tiny local notes CLI goal, available runtime details, public input examples, acceptance evidence expectations, and boundary warnings that prevent unrelated video-workbench artifacts from overriding the raw user goal.

files.content:
{
  "kind": "CGNKLocalLibrarianContextPack",
  "version": 1,
  "component_id": "librarian_initialization",
  "created_for_goal": "Build a tiny local notes CLI with README, tests, and delivery evidence",
  "primary_product_intent": {
    "product": "tiny local notes CLI",
    "must_be_runnable": true,
    "expected_user_value": "Create, list, read, search, and delete local notes from a command line without network services.",
    "recommended_storage": "local JSON file managed by the CLI",
    "recommended_language": "Python 3.12, matching the detected runtime",
    "recommended_testing": "pytest or standard-library unittest tests that exercise CLI behavior and persistence"
  },
  "available_runtime_context": {
    "python_version": "3.12.3",
    "platform": "win32",
    "ffmpeg_available": true,
    "notes": [
      "ffmpeg is available but is not needed for the requested notes CLI.",
      "The product should stay local-first and avoid external services."
    ]
  },
  "discovered_online_examples": [
    {
      "title": "Open-Meteo public API sample response",
      "source": "Open-Meteo",
      "modality": "json",
      "local_path": "D:/CGKN/artifacts/feasibility_live_smoke/input_examples/openmeteo_sample.json",
      "use_for_this_project": "Do not copy into the notes app. It is only evidence that JSON fixtures are available if a persistence-format example is useful."
    },
    {
      "title": "markdown-it/markdown-it repository metadata",
      "source": "GitHub public repository metadata",
      "modality": "repository_metadata",
      "local_path": "D:/CGKN/artifacts/feasibility_live_smoke/input_examples/github_repository_examples.json",
      "use_for_this_project": "Use only as general public repository metadata context; do not derive the app from this JavaScript markdown parser."
    }
  ],
  "acceptance_evidence_expected_downstream": {
    "readme": "README.md with install, usage, commands, storage behavior, and test instructions",
    "tests": "Automated tests for add/list/show/search/delete and persistence error handling",
    "test_report": "TEST_REPORT.md summarizing executed checks and results",
    "delivery_notes": "DELIVERY_NOTES.md explaining delivered files and how to reproduce",
    "run_dir": "A runtime evidence directory or generated artifacts proving commands were exercised"
  },
  "recommended_cli_contract": {
    "command_name": "notes",
    "commands": [
      "add <title> <body>",
      "list",
      "show <id>",
      "search <query>",
      "delete <id>",
      "export --format json"
    ],
    "storage_flag": "--store PATH for tests and isolated local usage",
    "exit_behavior": "Non-zero exit for missing notes, invalid IDs, malformed storage, or unsupported commands"
  },
  "boundary_guidance": {
    "raw_user_goal_is_authoritative": true,
    "do_not_implement_in_this_component": [
      "README.md",
      "application source code",
      "tests",
      "delivery reports",
      "video processing GUI",
      "media pipeline stages"
    ],
    "reason": "This component only discovers and packages context for downstream generation. Documentation, app code, tests, and delivery evidence belong to later components."
  },
  "handoff_to_project_generation": {
    "required_use": "Generate a tiny local notes CLI, not a video workbench, unless a later explicit component contract changes the product goal.",
    "quality_bar": [
      "Use deterministic local storage so tests can run offline.",
      "Keep the CLI small but complete enough to demonstrate real note lifecycle behavior.",
      "Provide runnable commands and evidence artifacts in downstream owned files."
    ]
  }
}

{
  "kind": "CGNKLocalLibrarianManifest",
  "version": 1,
  "component_id": "librarian_initialization",
  "owned_files": [
    "local_assets/context_pack.json",
    "local_assets/librarian_manifest.json"
  ],
  "exports": [
    {
      "name": "context_pack",
      "path": "local_assets/context_pack.json",
      "format": "json",
      "consumer": "project_generation",
      "contract": "Downstream generator reads primary_product_intent, recommended_cli_contract, acceptance_evidence_expected_downstream, and boundary_guidance before creating project files."
    }
  ],
  "source_inputs_summarized": [
    "raw_user_goal",
    "runtime_context",
    "online_input_examples",
    "acceptance_contract",
    "validation_errors_to_repair"
  ],
  "ownership_guardrails": {
    "does_not_own": [
      "README.md",
      "TEST_PLAN.md",
      "TEST_REPORT.md",
      "DELIVERY_NOTES.md",
      "application source files",
      "test source files"
    ],
    "repair_blocker_resolved": "No README.md or other docs-owned path is emitted by librarian_initialization."
  },
  "content_checks": [
    "context_pack.json is valid JSON",
    "context_pack.json names the tiny local notes CLI as the authoritative product intent",
    "context_pack.json includes downstream evidence expectations without generating those evidence files",
    "all emitted paths are under local_assets"
  ]
}

exports: local_assets/context_pack.json: JSON context pack consumed by project_generation
local_assets/librarian_manifest.json: JSON manifest documenting this component's owned files and exported context_pack contract

Validate local_assets/context_pack.json with a JSON parser.
Verify the context pack preserves the raw user goal as a tiny local notes CLI and flags unrelated video-workbench context as non-authoritative for this component handoff.
Confirm downstream project_generation can read recommended_cli_contract.commands and acceptance_evidence_expected_downstream.

checks: Only component-owned paths under local_assets are generated.
Generated files are non-empty, concrete JSON artifacts.
Repair blocker is addressed because README.md is not generated.

reasons: The component output is limited to librarian initialization artifacts.
The context pack is specific to the requested local notes CLI and includes actionable downstream contracts.
The generated files avoid placeholders, generic templates, binary assets, and paths outside the project root.
The output satisfies the component acceptance gate by building a usable context pack from available resources.
